source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Ranged attacks made by your **IMMORTALS** and **NECRON WARRIORS** units have **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)**. When one of those units is picked for an **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, it can still **[start an action](vsdata:core-rule/performing-actions)** despite that move. This Detachment carries the **DYNASTY** tag, so it cannot be combined with another **DYNASTY** Detachment.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 273 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
